== Possibly faulty data ==
* The Decipher Art Show list of 9 October 1999 covers Premiere through Jabba's Palace only. Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 reprints those captions (every HIDDEN EASTER EGGS page header, pp. 191–199, cites http://decipher.com/artshow/eastereggs/starwarsccg/index.html) and adds eggs Decipher did not post: [[Tonnika Sisters]], [[Tzizvvt]], [[Furry Fury]] lore (''The Mourning Bride''), [[Smuggler's Blues]], [[Swing-And-A-Miss]], [[Leia Of Alderaan]], Special Edition ([[Debnoli]], [[Death Star Assault Squadron]], [[Gambler's Luck]]), Reflections II ([[Corran Horn]], [[Talon Karrde]], [[Watch Your Step]]), [[Bravo Fighter]], [[Major Marquand]].
* Decipher per-card captions match the encyclopedia wording: [[Gravel Storm]] ("This Card Rocks"), [[Defel]] (WYOU/XERB), [[Luke's Hunting Rifle]] (Cream of Womprat and Joseph Campbell), [[Yavin 4: Briefing Room]] (Mariani, Reagan, Hudsol, Holland, Darcy).
* The 22 February 2002 www1 capture the encyclopedia also links has the same card roster as the 1999 list.
* Decipher's index spells the Dagobah card "Rogue Asteriod".

== Marginal cuts ==
* Lead sentence that yellow circles are the encyclopedia's callouts. Decipher circled eggs on the Art Show pages too. Wiki photographs are encyclopedia crops; File pages already credit them.
* Separate Sources list, including forum.starwarsccg.org t=8378 (Cloudflare; not opened this pass). Encyclopedia 3.2 p.199 already cites that thread.
* Closing sentence repeating that later-set rows are encyclopedia collector notes.
